scope: Upper application launch and mount contract assessment; read-only application code.

revisions.cashflow: Filesystem snapshot; no own Git checkout. Parent Workbench HEAD must not be used as consumer source revision.

claims.result: Existing Dispatcher namespace, dispatchOpenTile(parameters,tile), dispacthOpenCashflow(querys,type), and cross-app parameter envelopes preserve their signatures. Normal uniquely resolved authorized tiles need no upper-app source changes.
claims.old: First matching authorized catalog tile supplies parameters.
claims.new: One current admitted catalog tile supplies the same parameters; database tile identity is preserved separately as applicationTileId.
claims.limit: Only supplied cashflow consumer and shared wrapper paths were traced. Full enterprise consumer inventory is unavailable.

claims.result: entitlementScope:{tileId} is an additive optional prop. Container routing and remote wrappers forward it through existing props spreads. No supplied production consumer calls createAuthenticator or reads entitlementScope.
claims.upper_change: Only apps with conflicting same-feature provider/application routes need explicit adoption of the bound authenticator. Prop forwarding alone does not bind global permission calls.
claims.limit: Permission behavior is assessed separately by the permissions subtask.

claims.result: The new unique-match rule changes existing EMS2 dispatch and legacy deep-link results for duplicate catalog names/routes.
claims.old: dispatchOpenTile({},modal) creates a workspace and findTileConfig returns captured tile66.
claims.new: The dispatcher reports unauthorized/nonexistent; route lookup returns undefined. No workspace is created.
claims.policy_classification: Fails closed for ambiguous identity, but exceeds a role-only compatibility gap. First-match preservation has not been approved as intended policy.
claims.upper_change: Give caller/configuration an unambiguous locator before migrating duplicate launch targets. Current string-only public dispatcher has no ID argument.
claims.limit: The historical capture contains the trigger. No supplied upper app caller of modal was found; deployed occurrence is unverified.

claims.result: Stored workspace data is now a locator. Current catalog identity, module, tile, and container control mounted remote content. Removed or invalid tiles do not mount and are removed during revalidation.
claims.old: Container mounted persisted props and workspace validation happened after ready.
claims.new: Current authorized catalog tile is resolved on mount; new workspaces preserve database identity; old workspaces use a unique structural route fallback.
claims.upper_change: No normal app prop change. Revoked apps stop rendering; legacy ambiguous or unregistered programmatic workspaces may no longer open.
claims.limit: A missing catalog definition is intentionally denied. Remote import-map rollout and live revocation remain unverified.

claims.confidence: HIGH that callback chooses first; MEDIUM for reachable deployed impact
claims.result: Any replacement of entities, drawers, or entitlementRouting while ready is true now re-runs workspace validation and selects the first retained workspace. A valid currently selected later workspace can lose focus.
claims.new: Effect depends on ready, entities, drawers, and entitlementRouting; unchanged body dispatches validWorkspaces[0] as current.
claims.upper_change: No upper-app API fix. Shared shell should preserve current workspace when still valid, if this matches the intended navigation rule.
claims.limit: Static conditional consequence only. No browser focus reproduction or live frequency measurement ran.

claims.result: CES configuration needs the selected entitlementSource plus CES application ID, entity name, and feature. Admission uses the authoritative route catalog instead of the legacy X_RATANONE subject lookup.
claims.upper_change: Deployment/configuration prerequisite for migrated tiles; existing launch call need not change. Blank CES features are denied by the frontend.
claims.limit: Full maker/checker UI execution is unavailable.

claims.confidence: HIGH for exported source; UNKNOWN for absent external callers
claims.result: Existing public CommonUtil.validateTile and ChannelUtil.getSubject keep legacy entity/subject interpretation. New CES behavior is implemented through canOpenTile and route-aware mount/admission.
claims.upper_change: An external consumer bypassing the shared migrated flow must not assume these legacy helpers understand CES alias names. No such call was found in supplied cashflow/container production source.
claims.limit: This is a bounded caller search, not an enterprise-wide absence claim.

conditional_focus_source_comparison.classification: Static conditional side effect of intended revalidation. Not an executed browser defect.

limits: No live API or deployed browser session executed.
Cashflow consumer source is bound by SHA256 because it has no independent Git repository.
Other remotely imported MFEs are absent; no universal source compatibility guarantee is supported.
